remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Not recorded Whitney Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Back: O'Keeffe writing: 'Pink #1, 1918 o/c'" [not verified]. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 14. Downtown Gallery Archive, Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1919. Dated 1918 on basis of similarities to cat. nos. 256, 258. Titled *Pink & Blue* by Stieglitz on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
